author: mara
story: A company-wide shared list of hardware issues and workarounds that colleagues type in (no connector data in the shared collection). Jonas and Lea each add an issue, Tomas marks Jonas's workaround as helpful, and Sofia browses the list for the HPC-150 hardware.

input.workaround: Power-cycle the HMI board from the service menu; the charging module keeps running.

input.symptom: RFID reader ignores cards in frost
input.workaround: Enable the reader heater in the configuration, then restart the reader.
